zh-CN.summary: 双语对照翻译：Google 与自有 AI 模型同屏显示，原文译文并排阅读。
zh-CN.description: DualTran 是「双语对照」翻译：原文和译文同时留在页面上，而不是把原文替换掉。 主要特点 • 双引擎同屏 —— Google 翻译与任意 AI 模型可以同时运行，两种译文并排显示，方便互相对照 • 支持 20+ AI 服务商 —— OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、Moonshot、智谱 GLM、通义千问、Groq、OpenRouter、Ollama、LM Studio 等，用你自己的 API Key；密钥只保存在本机浏览器 • 划词翻译与整页翻译 —— 选中段落即时翻译，也可以一键翻译整页 • 只处理正文 —— 跳过代码块、公式与导航，尽量不破坏页面布局 • 隐私优先 —— 无需账号、没有统计、没有中转服务器；文本只发送给你选择的翻译服务 适合阅读外文文档、论文、GitHub issue、Reddit 与 X 的帖子，需要中英对照时尤其好用。 开源项目（MPL-2.0）：https://github.com/seigwen/DualTran-extension 问题反馈：https://github.com/seigwen/DualTran-extension/issues

en-US.summary: Bilingual translation: Google and your own AI model side by side, original and translation together.
en-US.description: DualTran keeps the original text on the page and puts the translation next to it, instead of replacing what you are reading. Highlights • Two engines at once — Google Translate and any AI model can run together, and both translations are shown side by side for comparison • 20+ AI providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu GLM, Qwen, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio and more, with your own API key; the key stays in your browser • Selection and full-page translation — translate a selected paragraph instantly, or the whole page in one click • Text only — code blocks, formulas and navigation are skipped so the layout stays intact • Privacy first — no account, no analytics, no relay server; text goes only to the translation service you choose Built for reading foreign-language documentation, papers, GitHub issues, and Reddit or X threads where you want the original and the translation together. Source (MPL-2.0): https://github.com/seigwen/DualTran-extension Issues: https://github.com/seigwen/DualTran-extension/issues
